Accidental Fire Destroys 19 Homes in Stourbridge

A fire that destroyed 19 homes in Stourbridge has been determined to have started accidentally, according to the fire service. Residents have begun returning to survey the damage to their fire-ravaged properties. The cause of the blaze was investigated by the fire service.
